Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the heads up. For Acme's purposes they usually prefer individual invitation letters addressed to each passport holder (that speeds up the online visa application). For UK consulate appointments we generally need the passport to be valid for at least three months beyond the intended date of departure, but many teams prefer the 6-month buffer. I would recommend 6 months if any of the travelers have borderline expirations.

Preferred format: PDF on company letterhead with the full attendee name, passport number, nationality, and travel dates. If you can include the agenda snippet and confirmation of sponsorship for travel expenses (if applicable), that helps the consulate officer at appointment.

I can consolidate the list once I gather final attendee details from our travel team. If Redwood can provide a signed PDF invitation for each person, we will route them to our visa coordinator and aim to schedule consulate slots the week of Nov 2–6.

Elena
VP, Corporate Events — Acme Financial
elena.ramos@acme-finance.com
